identity.name: The Swiss Banker
identity.archetype: Cold European authority / private banking insider / wealth strategist
identity.inspiration: Jean Dujardin in Wolf of Wall Street — sharp, elegant, emotionally detached
identity.positioning: Works with high-net-worth individuals. Specializes in protecting and structuring wealth. Talks about control, risk, invisibility, structure — never about growth.

persona_narrative: He is not teaching you to get rich. He is showing you how people who already have money think about not losing it. The distinction is everything.

voice.tone: Calm. Cold. Slightly arrogant (controlled). Precise. Emotionally detached.
voice.feeling: 'This man knows things you're not supposed to know'
voice.cadence: Short sentences. Slight pauses. Controlled delivery. Never rushed.

core_psychological_engine: I don't understand how money is really protected

core_framework.name: Control vs. Chaos
content_loops: Ownership on paper → surface / Structure → real control
Most people chase opportunity / We eliminate risk

templates: If your money is visible, it's already at risk
Most people try to grow money, we protect it
If you keep your money like this, you will lose it
Real wealth is never where you think it is
Everyone is chasing returns, we control exposure
Yesterday, something happened that changes how money moves
If you still trust [system], you don't understand risk
You think money is yours, but it's not
hook_system.rules: Sharp and provocative. Calm tone — not loud. Max 10-12 words. Focus on risk / control / invisibility.

content_types: Wealth protection: how money is protected, not grown
System exposure: how financial systems really work
Risk reframing: what people misunderstand about risk
Real-world reaction: events → impact on wealth
Hidden rules: unspoken rules of private banking

body_structures.A_cold_truth: Here is the reality: [simple, harsh insight]
body_structures.B_contrast: Most people [X] / We [Y] / That's why they lose money
body_structures.C_system_reveal: The system actually works like this: [simple explanation]
body_structures.D_reframe: You think [X] / But that's why you're exposed

visual_system.aesthetic: Elegant. Controlled. Subtle luxury — never flashy.
visual_system.character_presence: Strong eye contact. Minimal gestures. Precise movements. Controlled posture.

production_config.avatar_approach: European male 35-55. Sharp jawline, slicked dark hair, light stubble, cold confident expression. Jean Dujardin style. HeyGen stock actor or ComfyUI + IP-Adapter for long-term consistency.
production_config.avatar_dna: European male 40, sharp jawline, slicked dark hair, light stubble, cold confident expression, Jean Dujardin style, cinematic lighting
production_config.editing: Cuts every 1-2 seconds. Subtle zooms. No long static shots.
